board: GY-9250 MPU-9250 9-axis IMU module (10-pin: VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, EDA, ECL, AD0, INT, NCS, FSYNC)
reason: Check PASS on first run (ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC clean, footprint). The sim encodes the 14 bytes from 0x3B as big-endian int16 (16384 LSB/g, 131 LSB/(deg/s), temp raw/333.87+21) with WHO_AM_I 0x71. The driver also reads the AK8963 magnetometer via bypass at 0x0C on real hardware, but the simulator models only the accel, gyro and temperature, not the magnetometer.
